meta.title: FrankenPHP: the modern PHP app server
meta.description: FrankenPHP is a new app server for PHP apps (built on top of Caddy) and a library to embed the PHP interpreter in Go web servers.

footer.owner: Brought to you by Kévin Dunglas, creator of API Platform and Symfony Core Team member.

hero.title: The Modern PHP App Server, written in Go

gettingStarted.overtitle: One command to run them all
gettingStarted.title: Get started!
gettingStarted.content: Get a production-grade PHP server up and running in just one command!
gettingStarted.docker:
# Serve the public/ directory
docker run -v $PWD:/app/public \
  -p 443:443/tcp -p 443:443/udp \
  dunglas/frankenphp

# Run a command-line script
docker run -v $PWD:/app \
  dunglas/frankenphp php script.php
gettingStarted.standard:
# Install FrankenPHP on Linux or macOS
curl https://frankenphp.dev/install.sh | sh

# Or on Windows, with PowerShell
irm https://frankenphp.dev/install.ps1 | iex

# Serve the public/ directory
frankenphp php-server -r public/

# Run a command-line script
frankenphp php-cli script.php

modern.title: Moderner PHP Than Ever!
items: Uses the official PHP executor embedded in a state-of-the-art web server: Caddy
Native support for HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
Automatic HTTPS certificates generation and renewal (Let's Encrypt or ZeroSSL)
Copy your PHP files in the document root, that’s all!
Build standalone, self-executable and dependencies-free binaries for your PHP web applications, and command-line tools.
Popular PHP extensions, including OPcache and XDebug, are natively supported!

worker.overtitle: Make your PHP apps faster than ever!
worker.title: Worker mode

items.title: Worker script
items.content: Boot your app once, it stays in memory!

items.title: Straightforward
items.content: Natively supported by Symfony, API Platform, Laravel...

items.title: Simple
items.content: Uses plain old superglobals: no need for PSR-7.

items.title: Fast
items.content: According to our benchmarks, 3.5x faster than FPM on API Platform apps.

items.title: Efficient
items.content: FrankenPHP is written in Go and C. It relies on Go's iconic feature: goroutines!

items.title: Optional
items.content: Your app can be served as-is, even if it isn't compatible with the worker mode.

items.title: Easy Deploy
items.content: Runs in process: one binary, no external service needed.

items.title: Watcher
items.content: Automatically restart workers each time your code changes.

config.title: So easy to configure!
config.content: Three lines of config: it's now all you need to start a production-grade PHP server (automatic HTTPS, HTTP/3, zstd compression...), powered by Caddy.

items.title: Extensible
items.content: Compatible with PHP 8.2+, most PHP extensions and all Caddy modules.

items.title: Only one service
items.content: Designed with simplicity in mind: only one service, only one binary! FrankenPHP doesn't need PHP-FPM, it uses its own SAPI specially handcrafted for Go web servers.

items.title: Easy deploy
items.content: Cloud Native app shipped as a Docker image. Compatible with Kubernetes, and all modern cloud platforms. It's also possible to package your PHP app as a standalone, self-executable static binary.

items.title: Worker mode
items.content: Boot your application once and keep it in memory! It is ready to handle incoming requests in a few milliseconds.

items.title: 103 Early Hints
items.content: Early Hints are a brand new feature of the web platform that can improve website load times by 30%. FrankenPHP is the only PHP SAPI with Early Hints support!

items.title: Real-time
items.content: Built-in Mercure hub. Send events from your PHP apps to all connected browsers, they instantly receive the payload as a JavaScript event!

items.title: Brotli, Zstandard and Gzip compression
items.content: Modern compression formats are supported out-of-the-box.

items.title: Structured logging
items.content: Bring a more defined format and details to your logging.

items.title: Prometheus metrics and tracing
items.content: Built-in Prometheus support!

items.title: HTTP/2 & HTTP/3
items.content: Native support for HTTPS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.

items.title: HTTPS Automation
items.content: Automatic HTTPS certificate generation, renewal and revocation.

items.title: Graceful reload
items.content: Deploy your apps with zero downtime thanks to graceful reloads.

hero.title: Let’s create something great!
hero.content:
Les-Tilleuls.coop, the editors of FrankenPHP, provides a wide range of resources to help you make your app faster and more reliable.

If you’re looking for guidance on defining, building, and improving your infrastructure, you’re in the right place!

migration.title: Migrate your applications to FrankenPHP
migration.content: We migrate your infrastructure to FrankenPHP and train your teams on its use. This will enhance the stability of your infra, leading to increased productivity. Let's establish a migration plan now and work hand in hand with your teams for its implementation!

hosting.title: Hosting your projects with FrankenPHP
hosting.content:
We deploy and manage your PHP apps in production and take care of everything: monitoring, enforcing security, upgrading, optimizing performance…

In addition, we can manage your applications to the cloud technologies that best suit your needs (Kubernetes, GCP, AWS…) or your on premise servers.

services.title: A wide range of PHP services
services.content:
FrankenPHP is sponsored by Les-Tilleuls.coop, a French-based IT services company specializing in APIs, e-commerce, web, and cloud.

We are the creators of API Platform, co-maintainers of Symfony, members of the PHP Foundation’s advisory board, and contributors to more than 100 open-source solutions (Laravel, Kubernetes, PM2, Go…).

go.title: We are Go lovers
go.content: We are also major contributors to Go. We created Mercure, a simplified real-time open protocol and reference implementation written in this language, and Vulcain, an open protocol for fast and idiomatic client-driven REST APIs.
